head: 09921cb723a05d6c2ef37f1ae55a117de62d1e7e
classification_reasons: The change's own plan.md touches core gate enforcement (plugin/gate/checks.py, CHECKS_BY_PHASE, plugin/gate/diff.py, plugin/state/unpark.py, plugin/pr/description.py) and prose in docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md, affecting every project that runs the plugin, not just this repository (intent.md 'Affected users and systems').

No code for the new ratchets check exists yet (this diff is pre-implementation bookkeeping), so no existing test can be said to already cover it; the plan itself lists 20+ new unit tests still to be written.

Blast radius is wide by design: a new deterministic check runs at three gates (c, d, e) for every change type and interacts with the existing risk-list accept-risk label path across every project on the plugin.
attempted: Intent: confirmed this diff is not the feature work at all. It is the committed record of a CI preflight park (evidence/gate-c.json: check 'claude_md', reason 'CLAUDE.md does not name the lint command of sdlc.yaml') plus status.yaml's transition from phase b/passed to phase c/parked, and then the owner's sdlc:reset-iterations label being performed (iterations 1->0, panel_calls 3->0, iterations_reset_by/at set). This matches plugin/state/status.py's record_owner_label for RESET_ITERATIONS_LABEL exactly (it only zeroes the two counters and stamps the actor/time; it does not and should not touch parked_reason or gate.result), so the committed state is internally consistent with the code that produced it.

Spec/plan conformance: not applicable yet — plan.md's 'Files that change' and 'Order of work' name plugin/gate/diff.py, checks.py, unpark.py, pr/description.py, the skills/agent/template prose and the tests; none of those files appear in this diff, matching the task framing that no implementation session has started.

Proof: no test.log/build.log/lint.log/verifier.md changes are expected or present, because the phase (c) session that would produce them never started (preflight refused it before the session). Nothing in the diff claims a result that isn't backed by a toolchain run.

Blast radius: the two changed paths (evidence/gate-c.json, status.yaml) are both inside the change's own folder; no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) is touched in this diff. I checked the actual root cause independently: sdlc.yaml's lint command is 'python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .' and CLAUDE.md's current text only contains 'python -m ruff check .' (no '&&' form), so plugin/gate/preflight.py:check_claude_md will still fail on the next run — but the diff does not misrepresent this: it does not edit CLAUDE.md (a guardrail file a run must never edit) and status.yaml's parked_reason is left exactly as the preflight produced it, so the record is honest about remaining blocked rather than papering over it.

Policies: CLAUDE.md's own rule ('Editing a guardrail file ... propose the exact lines ... leave the edit to the owner') is respected — the diff contains no CLAUDE.md edit; the actual proposal lives in the uncommitted fix-response.md draft, outside this diff, which is the correct place for it.
Tests: none added, removed or weakened in this diff; nothing to check against existing coverage.

Checked whether the owner's sdlc:reset-iterations label application was a legitimate act rather than a workaround: plugin/state/unpark.py's is_automation_actor/rejection logic and status.yaml's iterations_reset_by: luissiviero confirm a human actor (not the automation identity), matching decision 11/24's rule that a run cannot un-park itself.
